arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 6000 m, 4.8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. CP from test: shaft 184 W, W prime 13.8 kJ; boat 124 W. For ~30 min race target shaft about 190 W (CP + Wprime/T). Start hot (shaft 247 W, pod reserve 72 pct). Let start settle; if shaft stays above ~200 W past 3 min, cue hold. Current +0.3 m/s along leg 1 (outbound), expect headwind/current on return legs: boat-speed reserve numbers will mislead there; trust pod (w_bal_pod_frac). Check CP calibration (10-25 pct off) by watching pod reserve vs feel.
